question.text: A retirement adviser shall NOT receive compensation from:

answer.text: Any person other than the prospect/subscriber being advised

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that a retirement adviser shall not receive consideration, remuneration, compensation, or any other form of payment from any person other than the prospect/subscriber being advised. The permitted payer is therefore the prospect/subscriber, and no one else. The Trap: Narrowing the permitted payer to only the "subscriber" misses the workbook's "prospect/subscriber" wording, which expressly covers the prospect stage as well. Note: This is a strict source-payer restriction — payments from PFMs, ASPs, PoPs or any other third party fall outside the permitted source.
